title: Atomic results comparison
description: One database snapshot for both charts, over all available comparable real and artificial drivers. Compatible public/development board entries are deduplicated by driver, choosing each driver's best race and flying lap. Artificial records remain development-gated and isolated from public competitive ranks. Exact placement replaces the player's retained entry with the display-only candidate, never writing records. No opponents means null comparison. Top ten display position; remaining positions show an upward-rounded top-percent threshold.
